completion_promises.evidence: Implemented conditional mounting in create_app (app.py:487-499) using voice_config.enabled flag. When disabled, voice routes return 404 (test_voice_routes_not_mounted_when_disabled). All 19 existing tests in test_app.py pass with zero modifications, confirming backward compatibility.

completion_promises.criterion_text: voice_audio streams audio/wav with correct content-type; miss ⇒ 404 without error_type
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented GET /api/sessions/{session_id}/voice-audio/{chunk_id} handler returning Response with media_type='audio/wav'. Chunk miss (ChunkStore.get returns None) maps to 404 with error field but NO error_type per binding §4.2 Rev 1. Tests test_voice_audio_happy_path and test_chunk_miss_is_transport_404 verify both cases.

completion_promises.criterion_text: serve-http boots with voice enabled and disabled (subprocess boot smoke pattern, test_serve_http.py:33-75, skipped without DSN)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented voice service wiring in cli/main.py:938-998 following the existing serve-http pattern. VoiceConfig.from_env reads environment variables (STUDY_TUTOR_VOICE_ENABLED, STT_BASE_URL, etc.), then conditionally builds AudioClient, ChunkStore, and VoiceTurnService when enabled. These are passed to create_app as optional parameters. Boot smoke test is skipped as mentioned in AC (requires DSN), but wiring follows production pattern.
